This approach addresses the degradation of high-frequency details caused by misalignment between rendered images and ground truth in dynamic or unbounded scenes [S1].

The evidence explicitly states that the proposed approach (AligNeRF) replaces standard per-pixel MSE loss with a combination of patch-based MSE (to account for misalignment) and a shallow VGG feature-space loss (to improve high-frequency details). It further confirms in the experiments section that the testbed consists of 'unbounded real-world scenes' and that misalignment prevents the recovery of high-frequency details, which the proposed method addresses.
